name.definitionEn: a language unit by which a person or thing is known
name.exampleEn: his name really is George Washington
he wanted to protect his good name

meet.exampleEn: I'll probably see you at the meeting

meet.definitionEn: get together socially or for a specific purpose
meet.exampleEn: Let's meet for coffee tomorrow afternoon to catch up.

friend.definitionEn: a person you know well and regard with affection and trust
friend.exampleEn: he was my best friend at the university

friend.definitionEn: an associate who provides cooperation or assistance
friend.exampleEn: he's a good ally in fight

new.definitionEn: not of long duration; having just (or relatively recently) come into being or been made or acquired or discovered
original and of a kind not seen before
new.exampleEn: the computer produced a completely novel proof of a well-known theorem

student.definitionEn: a learner who is enrolled in an educational institution
student.exampleEn: The student turned in her homework assignment on time yesterday.

student.definitionEn: a learned person (especially in the humanities); someone who by long study has gained mastery in one or more disciplines
student.exampleEn: He's a devoted student of medieval history who has written five books.

teacher.definitionEn: a person whose occupation is teaching
teacher.exampleEn: My high school teacher assigned us a ten-page essay on American history.

city.definitionEn: a large and densely populated urban area; may include several independent administrative districts
city.exampleEn: Ancient Troy was a great city

city.definitionEn: an incorporated administrative district established by state charter
city.exampleEn: the city raised the tax rate

live.definitionEn: inhabit or live in; be an inhabitant of
live.exampleEn: People lived in Africa millions of years ago

live.definitionEn: lead a certain kind of life; live in a certain style
live.exampleEn: we had to live frugally after the war

work.definitionEn: activity directed toward making or doing something
work.exampleEn: she checked several points needing further work

work.definitionEn: a product produced or accomplished through the effort or activity or agency of a person or thing
work.exampleEn: it is not regarded as one of his more memorable works

work.definitionEn: exert oneself by doing mental or physical work for a purpose or out of necessity
work.exampleEn: I will work hard to improve my grades

home.definitionEn: where you live at a particular time
home.exampleEn: deliver the package to my home

home.definitionEn: housing that someone is living in
home.exampleEn: he built a modest dwelling near the pond

here.definitionEn: in or at this place; where the speaker or writer is

here.translationFa: در این مورد، در این باره
here.definitionEn: in this circumstance or respect or on this point or detail

good.definitionEn: having desirable or positive qualities especially those suitable for a thing specified

morning.definitionEn: the time period between dawn and noon
morning.exampleEn: I spent the morning running errands

morning.definitionEn: a conventional expression of greeting or farewell
morning.exampleEn: She said good morning to her coworker as they passed in the hallway.

evening.definitionEn: the latter part of the day (the period of decreasing daylight from late afternoon until nightfall)
evening.exampleEn: he enjoyed the evening light across the lake
it was the evening of the Roman Empire

no.definitionEn: quantifier; used with either mass nouns or plural count nouns for indicating a complete or almost complete lack or zero quantity of

no.exampleEn: his no was loud and clear

no.definitionEn: a radioactive transuranic element synthesized by bombarding curium with carbon ions; 7 isotopes are known
no.exampleEn: Scientists discovered new isotopes of nobelium during the nuclear reaction experiments.

sorry.exampleEn: my finances were in a deplorable state

thanks.exampleEn: I gave thanks to my teacher for staying after class to help me.

thanks.definitionEn: with the help of or owing to
thanks.exampleEn: thanks to hard work it was a great success

thank.definitionEn: express gratitude or show appreciation to
thank.exampleEn: I thanked my mom for helping me move into my new apartment.

excuse.definitionEn: a defense of some offensive behavior or some failure to keep a promise etc.
excuse.exampleEn: he kept finding excuses to stay
he had to get his mother to write an excuse for him

repeat.definitionEn: to say, state, or perform again
make or do or perform again
repeat.exampleEn: He could never replicate his brilliant performance of the magic trick
the events today were a repeat of yesterday's

pen.definitionEn: a writing implement with a point from which ink flows
pen.exampleEn: I signed the contract with my favorite pen.
The farmer let the sheep out of their pen.

book.translationFa: اثر نوشته‌شده‌ای که منتشر شده است
book.definitionEn: a written work or composition that has been published (printed on pages bound together)
book.exampleEn: I am reading a good book on economics

book.definitionEn: physical objects consisting of a number of pages bound together
book.exampleEn: he used a large book as a doorstop

table.definitionEn: a set of data arranged in rows and columns
a piece of furniture having a smooth flat top that is usually supported by one or more vertical legs

water.definitionEn: binary compound that occurs at room temperature as a clear colorless odorless tasteless liquid; freezes into ice below 0 degrees centigrade and boils above 100 degrees centigrade; widely used as a solvent
water.exampleEn: I drank a cold glass of water after my morning run.

water.definitionEn: the part of the earth's surface covered with water (such as a river or lake or ocean)

tea.translationFa: نوشیدنی که از دم کردن برگ های چای در آب تهیه می شود
tea.definitionEn: a beverage made by steeping tea leaves in water
tea.exampleEn: iced tea is a cooling drink

tea.translationFa: وعده ای سبک در بعد از ظهر با چای و ساندویچ یا کیک
tea.definitionEn: a light midafternoon meal of tea and sandwiches or cakes
tea.exampleEn: an Englishman would interrupt a war to have his afternoon tea

coffee.definitionEn: a beverage consisting of an infusion of ground coffee beans
coffee.exampleEn: he ordered a cup of coffee

coffee.definitionEn: any of several small trees and shrubs native to the tropical Old World yielding coffee beans
coffee.exampleEn: The coffee plants in our greenhouse require warm temperatures and plenty of shade.

room.definitionEn: an area within a building enclosed by walls and floor and ceiling
room.exampleEn: the rooms were very small but they had a nice view

five.exampleEn: She has five brothers, so family dinners are always loud and chaotic.

five.definitionEn: the cardinal number that is the sum of four and one
five.exampleEn: I counted five apples in the bowl on the kitchen table.
The coach pulled his five off the court for a quick timeout.

dollar.translationFa: واحد پولی پایه در بسیاری از کشورها؛ برابر با ۱۰۰ سنت
dollar.definitionEn: the basic monetary unit in many countries; equal to 100 cents
dollar.exampleEn: The exchange rate shows one dollar equals about ninety cents Canadian.

dollar.definitionEn: a piece of paper money worth one dollar
dollar.exampleEn: I found a crumpled dollar bill in my jacket pocket yesterday.

time.definitionEn: an instance or single occasion for some event
a period of time considered as a resource under your control and sufficient to accomplish something
time.exampleEn: take time to smell the roses

have.definitionEn: have or possess, either in a concrete or an abstract sense

have.exampleEn: This restaurant features the most famous chefs in France

help.definitionEn: give help or assistance; be of service
help.exampleEn: Everyone helped out during the earthquake
These pills will help the patient
